ListBox.reason: ListBox is an internal composition primitive (ListBox/ListBoxField/ListBoxMenu/ListBoxMenuItem/ListBoxSelection/etc.) used by React to build Dropdown, ComboBox, and MultiSelect. It has no standalone Storybook story or public docs page in Carbon React and is not a component consumers use directly. It will be covered implicitly when Dropdown/ComboBox/MultiSelect are implemented in Ember; no standalone Ember component makes sense.
